##: Master copy -- see packaging/scoop/README. The version, url, hash and extract_dir
below are a starting point only: `scoop checkver luvie . -u` rewrites all four from
the autoupdate block at the bottom, so the hash placeholder is expected to be wrong
until it has been run once against a published release.
description: Pattern-based MIDI sequencer, as a standalone application and an LV2 plugin
notes: The LV2 plugin has been installed to %APPDATA%\LV2\luvie.lv2 -- rescan your
plugins in Reaper, Ardour or Carla and Luvie will appear.
JACK is optional: Luvie uses the native Windows MIDI API on its own, and picks up
JACK transport and JACK MIDI ports at runtime if JACK is installed.
post_install: # Scoop keeps the app in its own directory, but a host will only look for plugin
# bundles in the standard places -- so this half cannot stay where it was unpacked.
